inlines.v: SCARECROW, noun [scarce and crow.] 1. Any frightful thing set up to frighten crows or other fowls from corn fields; hence, any thing terrifying without danger; a vain terror. A scarecrow set to frighten fools away. 2. A fowl of the sea gull kind; the black gull.
